title: Requests to paths that merely contain /health skip the API key check
author: lee-fixture
body:
The README says every endpoint except `/health` needs the `X-Api-Key` header. In practice any path that has `/health` somewhere in it is let through without a key.

Only the exact health probe should be exempt. Nothing else is routed under such a path today, so this is not exploitable yet, but the next endpoint someone adds under a path like that would be public by accident.
